topic: Volcanic Eruptions and Earth Surface Changes
key_concepts: A volcano is an opening in Earth's crust that ejects lava, pyroclastic materials, and gase
High temperature inside Earth melts rocks to form magma.
Pressure buildup deep inside Earth causes magma to rise and escape through vents or crater
Magma that reaches the surface is called lava.
Repeated lava flows can build up volcanic mountains.
Main parts of a volcano include the magma chamber, conduits, vents, and craters.
Less dense magma and expanding gases in the magma chamber increase pressure and can trigge
Volcanic eruptions release ash and gases that can harm health, destroy property, and ruin
Volcanic eruptions can create new land and make soil fertile.
Volcanic eruptions can cause landslides, mudflows, lava flows, and ash deposits.
